question: On p1, list the public subprograms of SHOPAPP.WORKLOAD and distinguish them from the package itself.

question: On p1, map every SHOPAPP.WORKLOAD subprogram to each table it writes and the kind of write. Include multiple operations on the same table; distinguish reads from writes.

groundTruth.sql: SELECT (SELECT UPPER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(p.text,'PROCEDURE +([a-z_]+)',1,1,'i',1)) FROM dba_source p WHERE p.owner=s.owner AND p.name=s.name AND p.type=s.type AND p.line=(SELECT MAX(h.line) FROM dba_source h WHERE h.owner=s.owner AND h.name=s.name AND h.type=s.type AND h.line<s.line AND REGEXP_LIKE(h.text,'PROCEDURE +','i'))) AS subprogram,UPPER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(s.text,'(INSERT INTO|UPDATE|DELETE FROM) +([a-z_]+)',1,1,'i',2)) AS table_name,UPPER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(s.text,'INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE',1,1,'i')) AS operation FROM dba_source s WHERE s.owner='SHOPAPP' AND s.name='WORKLOAD' AND s.type='PACKAGE BODY' AND REGEXP_LIKE(s.text,'^ *(INSERT INTO|UPDATE|DELETE FROM) ','i') ORDER BY s.line

question: On p1, investigate the recorded NIGHTLY_PURGE_JOB referential-integrity failure. Identify the error, constraint, child table and column, parent table and column, and delete rule; explain why deleting the parent can be blocked.

groundTruth.sql: SELECT 'CHILD' AS role,c.table_name AS table_name,cc.column_name AS column_name FROM all_constraints c JOIN all_cons_columns cc ON cc.owner=c.owner AND cc.constraint_name=c.constraint_name JOIN all_constraints p ON p.owner=c.r_owner AND p.constraint_name=c.r_constraint_name JOIN all_cons_columns pc ON pc.owner=p.owner AND pc.constraint_name=p.constraint_name AND pc.position=cc.position WHERE c.owner='SHOPAPP' AND c.constraint_name=(SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR(additional_info,'SHOPAPP[.]([A-Z0-9_]+)',1,1,NULL,1) FROM dba_scheduler_job_run_details WHERE owner='SHOPAPP' AND job_name='NIGHTLY_PURGE_JOB' AND status='FAILED' ORDER BY log_id DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY) UNION ALL SELECT 'PARENT' AS role,p.table_name AS table_name,pc.column_name AS column_name FROM all_constraints c JOIN all_cons_columns cc ON cc.owner=c.owner AND cc.constraint_name=c.constraint_name JOIN all_constraints p ON p.owner=c.r_owner AND p.constraint_name=c.r_constraint_name JOIN all_cons_columns pc ON pc.owner=p.owner AND pc.constraint_name=p.constraint_name AND pc.position=cc.position WHERE c.owner='SHOPAPP' AND c.constraint_name=(SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR(additional_info,'SHOPAPP[.]([A-Z0-9_]+)',1,1,NULL,1) FROM dba_scheduler_job_run_details WHERE owner='SHOPAPP' AND job_name='NIGHTLY_PURGE_JOB' AND status='FAILED' ORDER BY log_id DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY)

question: On p1, trace the most recent recorded NIGHTLY_PURGE_JOB failure back to the package body: give the package line, enclosing subprogram, and failing operation and table. Distinguish the package frame from the outer block frame.

groundTruth.sql: SELECT fact FROM (SELECT TO_CHAR(line) AS source_line,subprogram,operation,table_name FROM (SELECT s.line,UPPER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(h.text,'PROCEDURE +([a-z_]+)',1,1,'i',1)) AS subprogram,UPPER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(s.text,'DELETE',1,1,'i')) AS operation,UPPER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(s.text,'DELETE FROM +([a-z_]+)',1,1,'i',1)) AS table_name FROM dba_source s JOIN dba_source h ON h.owner=s.owner AND h.name=s.name AND h.type=s.type AND h.line=(SELECT MAX(x.line) FROM dba_source x WHERE x.owner=s.owner AND x.name=s.name AND x.type=s.type AND x.line<s.line AND REGEXP_LIKE(x.text,'PROCEDURE +','i')) WHERE s.owner='SHOPAPP' AND s.name='WORKLOAD' AND s.type='PACKAGE BODY' AND s.line=(SELECT TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(additional_info,'WORKLOAD", line ([0-9]+)',1,1,NULL,1)) FROM dba_scheduler_job_run_details WHERE owner='SHOPAPP' AND job_name='NIGHTLY_PURGE_JOB' AND status='FAILED' ORDER BY log_id DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY))) UNPIVOT (fact FOR item IN (source_line,subprogram,operation,table_name))

question: On d1, what does the most recent recorded failed run of K7Q_OWNER.K7Q_FAILJOB report? Give the scheduler status, Oracle error code, application message and source line. Base your diagnosis on recorded evidence and distinguish an application-raised error from a foreign-key error.
